kana.title: Hiragana & Katakana
kana.dakuten_intro: Dakuten (゛), or "tenten", is a two-stroke mark at the upper right of a character. It turns a voiceless consonant sound into a voiced one: k→g, s→z, t→d, h→b.
kana.handakuten_intro: Handakuten (゜), or "maru", is a small circle at the upper right of a character. It is only used on the h-row, turning h→p.
kana.yoon_intro: Yoon combine a consonant+i kana (き, し, に, ...) with a small ya/yu/yo, read as a single syllable: きゃ is read "kya", not "ki-ya".
kana.yoon_dakuten_intro: The voiced form of the yoon above, using the dakuten/handakuten rows (が, じ, び, ぴ, etc.) as the consonant.

kanji.sources_intro: Character, stroke-order, reading, meaning, and vocabulary data in the Kanji module comes from the open-source projects below. All are licensed Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike — we're required to credit them, and the automatically-generated Indonesian translations of this data carry the same license.
kanji.sources_kanjivg_used_for: Source of stroke shapes and order for the animation and writing-practice widgets.
kanji.sources_kanjidic_used_for: Source of characters, on'yomi/kun'yomi readings, English meanings, school grade, and frequency rank.
kanji.sources_jmdict_used_for: Source of example vocabulary for each kanji, with readings and meanings.
kanji.sources_disclaimer: The JLPT level classification (N5-N1) used here is maintained separately from the data above, since the Japan Foundation has not published an official per-level kanji list since 2010 — the list used is a common consensus drawn from JLPT prep materials.

home.rule_order: Sections are taken in order and can't be redone within one test.
home.rule_timer: Each section has a time limit. The clock runs on the server: closing the page or refreshing doesn't pause or reset it. When time runs out, your answers are submitted automatically.
home.rule_no_feedback: No right/wrong feedback during the exam. All scores appear in the recap once the test is finished.
home.rule_pass: You pass with a total of at least {n} and the minimum score in every part.
home.partial_notice: Only some sections are available so far. A provisional recap still appears after the available sections are done, but there is no pass/fail decision until every section exists.
home.abandon_body: All answers and sections in this test will be discarded, and you can start a new test from scratch.
home.mode_strict_hint: Exam conditions: each section is timed (on the server), audio plays once, and there is no right/wrong feedback during the test. Earns XP.
home.mode_practice_hint: No time limit. Each answer is marked right/wrong right away with an explanation, and listening audio can be replayed (original packs). Earns no XP.
home.rule_practice: Practice mode: feedback appears after you pick an answer, and you can change it.

jlptMock.title: JLPT Mock Test
jlptMock.subtitle: A full JLPT mock exam: 3 sections, time limits, audio that plays automatically, and an answer sheet — just like the real thing.
jlptMock.mode_strict_hint: Timed sections, audio plays once and automatically, you cannot go back to a finished section. Earns XP.
jlptMock.mode_practice_hint: No time limit, audio can be replayed and you continue manually. No XP.
jlptMock.furigana: Show furigana (not present in the real exam)
jlptMock.about_scoring: Scores here are estimates. The real JLPT uses equated scaled scores that cannot be computed from the number of correct answers alone, so raw counts are scaled linearly to the official ranges (language 0–120, listening 0–60). The N5 pass rule matches the real one: total at least 80, language at least 38, listening at least 19.
jlptMock.about_audio: Listening audio is generated with Google TTS, so it does not sound like the real exam recordings. Use headphones and find a quiet place.
jlptMock.load_error: Could not load the test. Please try again in a moment.
jlptMock.exit_body: Your answers are not saved and the test will be lost.
jlptMock.leave_confirm: A test is in progress. Leave now? Your answers will be lost.
jlptMock.time_up: Time ran out on the previous section. Answers you had marked still count.
jlptMock.rule_reading_1: Read each question on screen and choose the single best answer (1–4).
jlptMock.rule_reading_2: You can change answers any time until the time for this section is up. Open the Answer sheet to see unanswered questions.
jlptMock.rule_reading_3: Use the flag on questions you want to double-check.
jlptMock.rule_reading_timer: The {n}-minute timer starts when you press start. When it runs out the section is submitted automatically.
jlptMock.rule_listening_1: The audio contains instructions, an example, then numbered questions. Each question plays only once.
jlptMock.rule_listening_2: Choose your answer while the audio plays or during the answer pause. Once the next question starts, you cannot change it.
jlptMock.rule_listening_3_strict: Audio runs on its own until the end. There is no pause or replay button.
jlptMock.rule_listening_3_practice: Practice mode: audio can be replayed and you continue with the Next button.
jlptMock.rule_no_back: Once you submit this section you cannot return to it.
jlptMock.sheet_hint: Tap a number to jump to the question, or tap a bubble to mark an answer. Numbers outlined in yellow are unanswered.
jlptMock.finish_body: After submitting you cannot return to this section.
